title: Greek Chicken Bowls
description: Lemon-oregano chicken over herbed rice with cucumber, tomato and tzatziki.
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon juice, oregano, olive oil, salt and pepper for 15 minutes.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Grill or pan-sear chicken 6–7 minutes per side, then rest and slice.
Dice cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
Build bowls with rice, chicken and vegetables; top with tzatziki.

title: Salmon Teriyaki with Greens
description: Glazed salmon fillets with garlicky bok choy and jasmine rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Whisk teriyaki sauce with honey.
Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes, flip, brush with glaze and cook 3 more minutes.
Stir-fry bok choy with garlic for 3 minutes.
Serve salmon over rice with greens; garnish with sesame and spring onion.

title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
description: A creamy, warming curry that comes together in one pot.
steps: Sauté onion until soft, then add garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Season and serve with rice or naan.

title: Turkey Taco Lettuce Wraps
description: Light, crunchy tacos with seasoned ground turkey.
steps: Brown turkey with taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Separate lettuce leaves into cups.
Fill with turkey, pico de gallo, avocado and cheese.
Finish with a squeeze of lime.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
description: Bright quinoa salad with feta, olives and a lemon vinaigrette.
steps: Cook quinoa and let it cool.
Chop cucumber, tomatoes, olives and parsley.
Whisk lemon juice with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Toss everything together and top with feta.

title: Overnight Oats with Berries
description: Make-ahead breakfast with oats, chia and fresh berries.
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, chia and maple syrup together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with berries in the morning.

title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Takeout-style beef and broccoli in a savory garlic sauce.
steps: Slice steak thinly against the grain and toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornstarch.
Sear beef in batches over high heat; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli 3 minutes with garlic and ginger.
Return beef, add remaining soy and oyster sauce, toss 1 minute.
Serve over rice.

title: Black Bean Sweet Potato Tacos
description: Roasted sweet potato and smoky black beans in warm tortillas.
steps: Dice sweet potatoes, toss with oil, paprika and cumin; roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Warm black beans with a pinch of cumin.
Warm tortillas.
Fill with sweet potato, beans, avocado and cilantro; add lime.

title: Shrimp Scampi Zoodles
description: Garlic-butter shrimp tossed with zucchini noodles.
steps: Melt butter and sauté garlic with chili flakes for 1 minute.
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
Add zucchini noodles and lemon juice; toss 2 minutes.
Finish with parsley and parmesan.

title: Lentil Bolognese
description: Hearty plant-based bolognese over whole-wheat pasta.
steps: Finely dice onion, carrot and celery; sauté 8 minutes.
Add garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add lentils, tomatoes, seasoning and 2 cups water; simmer 30 minutes.
Cook pasta and toss with the sauce.

title: Egg & Veggie Breakfast Scramble
description: Protein-packed scramble with peppers, spinach and feta.
steps: Sauté onion and pepper until soft.
Add spinach until wilted.
Pour in whisked eggs and stir gently until just set.
Top with feta and serve with toast.

title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken
description: Chicken thighs roasted with potatoes and green beans on one pan.
steps: Heat oven to 425°F.
Toss halved potatoes with oil, salt and rosemary; roast 15 minutes.
Add chicken rubbed with garlic, lemon zest and oil; roast 20 minutes.
Add green beans and lemon slices; roast 10 more minutes.

title: Tofu Pad Thai
description: Sweet, tangy rice noodles with crispy tofu and peanuts.
steps: Soak noodles in hot water until pliable.
Press and cube tofu; pan-fry until golden.
Whisk tamari, lime juice and sugar.
Toss noodles with sauce, tofu and sprouts over high heat for 2 minutes.
Top with spring onions and crushed peanuts.

title: Tuna Poke Bowl
description: Fresh sushi-grade tuna with rice, edamame and avocado.
steps: Cook and cool the rice.
Cube tuna and toss with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Slice avocado and cucumber.
Assemble bowls with rice, tuna, edamame, avocado and cucumber; garnish with ginger and nori.

title: Caprese Stuffed Portobellos
description: Roasted mushrooms filled with tomato, mozzarella and basil.
steps: Heat oven to 400°F; brush mushrooms with oil.
Fill with halved tomatoes and mozzarella.
Roast 15 minutes.
Top with basil and balsamic glaze.

title: Rainbow Raw Veggie Wraps
description: No-cook collard wraps with hummus and crunchy vegetables.
steps: Trim collard stems so leaves lie flat.
Spread hummus down the center.
Layer julienned vegetables, avocado and sprouts.
Roll tightly like a burrito and slice in half.

title: Chicken Fajita Sheet Pan
description: Smoky chicken, peppers and onions roasted together and piled into warm tortillas.
steps: Heat oven to 425°F.
Toss chicken, sliced peppers and onion with oil and seasoning on a sheet pan.
Roast 20–25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Squeeze lime over the pan and serve in warm tortillas with sour cream and salsa.

title: Turkey Meatballs with Marinara
description: Tender herbed turkey meatballs simmered in a quick tomato sauce.
steps: Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, garlic and seasoning; roll into 16 balls.
Brown meatballs in an oiled skillet, about 6 minutes.
Add marinara, cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Top with basil; serve over pasta or with crusty bread.

title: Korean Beef Rice Bowls
description: Sweet-savory ground beef with garlic and ginger over rice with quick-pickled cucumbers.
steps: Toss sliced cucumber with a splash of rice vinegar and salt.
Brown beef with garlic and ginger.
Stir in soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil; simmer 2 minutes.
Serve over rice with cucumbers and spring onions.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Charred yogurt-marinated chicken in a creamy spiced tomato sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and 1 tbsp paste for 15 minutes.
Sear chicken until charred; set aside.
Soften onion and garlic, add remaining paste and tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and chicken; simmer 8 minutes. Serve with rice and cilantro.

title: Pork Carnitas Bowls
description: Crispy citrus-braised pork with black beans, rice and pico de gallo.
steps: Season pork with cumin, oregano, salt and pepper.
Braise with orange and lime juice, onion and garlic, covered, at 325°F for 2 hours.
Shred, then crisp under the broiler for 5 minutes.
Serve over rice and beans with pico de gallo.

title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
description: Grilled chicken, crisp romaine and parmesan in a creamy Caesar wrap.
steps: Season and grill chicken 6 minutes per side; slice.
Toss chopped romaine with dressing, parmesan and a squeeze of lemon.
Fill tortillas with salad and chicken; roll tightly and halve.

title: Beef and Vegetable Chili
description: Hearty weeknight chili loaded with beans and vegetables.
steps: Brown beef with diced onion and pepper.
Add zucchini, spices, tomatoes and beans with 1 cup water.
Simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Top with cheddar and sour cream.

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Orzo
description: One-pot orzo with chicken, spinach and a bright lemon finish.
steps: Brown chicken in olive oil; add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add orzo and broth; simmer, stirring, 10–12 minutes.
Stir in spinach, lemon zest and juice, and parmesan.

title: Breakfast Burritos
description: Make-ahead burritos with eggs, sausage, potatoes and cheese.
steps: Crisp potatoes in a skillet, about 12 minutes; set aside.
Brown sausage, then scramble in the eggs.
Fill tortillas with potatoes, eggs, sausage and cheese; roll.
Serve with salsa, or wrap and freeze for busy mornings.

title: Thai Basil Chicken
description: Fast stir-fry of chicken, chilies and holy basil over jasmine rice.
steps: Stir-fry garlic and chilies 30 seconds.
Add chicken and cook until browned.
Add sauces and sugar; toss in basil until wilted.
Serve over rice, topped with a fried egg if you like.

title: Lemon Herb Baked Cod
description: Flaky cod baked with lemon, garlic and herbs alongside roasted asparagus.
steps: Heat oven to 400°F.
Arrange cod and asparagus on a sheet pan.
Brush with butter mixed with garlic, lemon zest and parsley.
Bake 12–15 minutes; finish with lemon juice.

title: Fish Tacos with Lime Slaw
description: Crispy seasoned white fish with a tangy cabbage slaw.
steps: Toss cabbage with yogurt, lime juice and salt.
Season fish with spices and sear 3 minutes per side; flake.
Warm tortillas and fill with fish and slaw; top with cilantro.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp & Rice
description: Juicy shrimp in garlic butter over fluffy rice with green beans.
steps: Steam green beans 5 minutes.
Melt butter, add garlic and pepper flakes.
Cook shrimp 2 minutes per side; finish with lemon.
Serve over rice with green beans.

title: Mediterranean Tuna Salad
description: No-mayo tuna salad with white beans, olives and herbs.
steps: Drain tuna and beans.
Combine with chopped olives, onion, tomatoes and parsley.
Dress with lemon juice and a drizzle of the tuna oil; season.

title: Miso Glazed Salmon
description: Caramelized miso salmon with sesame broccoli.
steps: Whisk miso, honey, vinegar and soy sauce.
Brush over salmon; broil 8–10 minutes until caramelized.
Roast broccoli at 425°F for 15 minutes; sprinkle with sesame.

title: Shrimp Pad See Ew
description: Wide rice noodles stir-fried with shrimp, Chinese broccoli and egg.
steps: Soak noodles until pliable.
Sear shrimp with garlic; push aside and scramble eggs.
Add broccoli and noodles with sauces and sugar.
Toss over high heat 2–3 minutes until glossy.

title: Smoked Salmon Bagel Board
description: Bagels with smoked salmon, herbed cream cheese and fresh toppings.
steps: Stir dill into cream cheese.
Toast bagels.
Spread cream cheese and layer salmon, cucumber, onion and capers.
Finish with lemon and black pepper.

title: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Shells
description: Jumbo pasta shells filled with ricotta and spinach, baked in marinara.
steps: Boil shells until just al dente.
Mix ricotta, spinach, egg and half the cheeses.
Fill shells and arrange over marinara in a baking dish.
Top with remaining cheese; bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

title: Veggie Fried Rice
description: Day-old rice fried with eggs, peas, carrots and soy.
steps: Scramble eggs in a hot wok; set aside.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables 2 minutes.
Add rice and soy sauce; fry until hot and slightly crisp.
Fold in eggs, spring onions and sesame oil.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Soften onion and pepper; add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in eggs; cover and cook 6–8 minutes.
Crumble feta on top; serve with bread.

title: Margherita Flatbread
description: Crisp flatbread with tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil.
steps: Heat oven to 450°F.
Spread sauce over flatbreads; top with mozzarella and halved tomatoes.
Bake 10–12 minutes until bubbling.
Finish with basil and olive oil.

title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
description: Layers of Greek yogurt, granola, berries and honey.
steps: Layer yogurt, berries and granola in a glass.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with chia.

title: Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Cheesy quesadillas with black beans, corn and peppers.
steps: Sauté pepper and corn with cumin; stir in mashed beans.
Fill tortillas with beans and cheese; fold.
Cook in a dry skillet 3 minutes per side until golden.
Cut into wedges; serve with salsa and guacamole.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy arborio rice with sautéed mushrooms and parmesan.
steps: Sauté mushrooms until golden; set aside.
Soften shallot, add rice and toast 1 minute; add wine.
Add broth a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 20 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms, butter, parmesan and thyme.

title: Caprese Pasta Salad
description: Pasta tossed with tomatoes, mozzarella, basil and balsamic.
steps: Cook pasta, rinse under cold water and drain.
Toss with tomatoes, mozzarella, basil and olive oil.
Season and drizzle with balsamic glaze.

title: Vegan Buddha Bowl
description: Roasted chickpeas and sweet potato over quinoa with tahini dressing.
steps: Roast cubed sweet potato and chickpeas with paprika at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Cook quinoa.
Massage kale with a little lemon and salt.
Whisk tahini, lemon and water; assemble bowls and drizzle.

title: Red Lentil Dal
description: Silky spiced lentils finished with a sizzling cumin tadka.
steps: Simmer lentils with turmeric in 4 cups water for 15 minutes.
Sauté onion, garlic and ginger; add to lentils with coconut milk.
Sizzle cumin seeds in oil and pour over the dal.
Top with cilantro; serve with rice.

title: Peanut Noodle Stir-Fry
description: Noodles and crunchy vegetables in a creamy peanut-lime sauce.
steps: Cook noodles; rinse.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime, maple and warm water.
Stir-fry sliced vegetables 3 minutes.
Toss with noodles and sauce; top with peanuts.

title: Tofu Scramble
description: Turmeric-spiced tofu scramble with peppers and spinach.
steps: Sauté onion and pepper until soft.
Crumble in tofu with turmeric and nutritional yeast.
Cook 5 minutes, then fold in spinach until wilted.

title: Minestrone Soup
description: Classic Italian vegetable soup with beans and pasta.
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery 8 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, beans and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Stir in spinach; season.

title: Chickpea Salad Sandwiches
description: Smashed chickpeas with crunchy celery and a lemony dressing.
steps: Mash chickpeas with a fork.
Mix in diced celery and onion, mayo, Dijon and lemon.
Build sandwiches with lettuce and tomato.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Peppers filled with rice, black beans, corn and salsa.
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; halve and seed the peppers.
Mix rice, beans, corn, salsa and cumin.
Fill peppers, cover with foil and bake 30 minutes.
Top with sliced avocado.

title: Coconut Chia Pudding
description: Make-ahead chia pudding with coconut milk and mango.
steps: Whisk chia, coconut milk, maple and vanilla.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with diced mango.

title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
description: Spiralized zucchini tossed with basil-walnut pesto and tomatoes.
steps: Blend basil, walnuts, garlic, olive oil and lemon into a pesto.
Toss zucchini noodles with pesto.
Top with halved tomatoes and season.

title: Thai Mango Salad
description: Crunchy mango and vegetable salad with a lime-chili dressing.
steps: Julienne mango, pepper and carrot.
Whisk lime juice, maple and minced chili.
Toss with cabbage and cilantro; top with cashews.

title: Green Power Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick spinach, banana and mango smoothie bowl with crunchy toppings.
ingredients: Toppings: berries, hemp seeds, sliced kiwi
steps: Blend banana, mango, spinach, almond milk and almond butter until thick.
Pour into a bowl and add toppings.

title: Raw Energy Bites
description: No-bake date and nut bites for an easy snack.
steps: Pulse almonds in a food processor until coarse.
Add dates, cacao, chia, almond butter and salt; blend until sticky.
Roll into 12 balls and chill 30 minutes.

title: Avocado Toast with Tomatoes
description: Smashed avocado on toasted sourdough with cherry tomatoes and chili flakes.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread on toast and top with halved tomatoes and chili flakes.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Fluffy dairy-free pancakes made from oats and ripe banana.
steps: Blend oats, bananas, oat milk, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth.
Rest the batter 5 minutes.
Cook 1/4-cup portions in a lightly oiled pan, 2 minutes per side.
Serve with maple syrup.

title: Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
description: Crispy sweet potato with peppers, onion and black beans.
steps: Dice sweet potato, pepper and onion.
Cook sweet potato in olive oil for 10 minutes until golden.
Add pepper, onion and paprika; cook 6 minutes.
Stir in rinsed beans until warm and season.

title: Spinach Feta Omelette
description: A quick three-egg omelette folded around wilted spinach and feta.
steps: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Wilt spinach in butter, then pour in eggs.
Cook until nearly set, add feta and fold.

title: Veggie Egg Muffins
description: Make-ahead egg cups loaded with peppers, spinach and cheese.
steps: Heat oven to 375°F and grease a muffin tin.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Divide chopped vegetables and cheese between cups and pour over the egg.
Bake 18–20 minutes until set.

title: Turkey Sausage Breakfast Skillet
description: Turkey sausage, potatoes and peppers topped with fried eggs.
steps: Quarter potatoes and cook in olive oil for 12 minutes.
Add crumbled sausage, pepper and onion; cook through.
Make four wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs are set.

title: Salmon & Avocado Rice Cakes
description: Crisp rice cakes topped with smoked salmon, avocado and dill.
steps: Mash avocado with lemon juice.
Spread on rice cakes.
Top with smoked salmon, dill and black pepper.

title: Raw Buckwheat Porridge
description: Soaked buckwheat blended with banana and topped with fresh fruit.
ingredients: 1 cup raw buckwheat groats, soaked overnight
steps: Drain and rinse the soaked buckwheat.
Blend with banana, water and cinnamon until creamy.
Top with berries and hemp seeds.

title: Tropical Fruit & Coconut Bowl
description: Mango, pineapple and kiwi with coconut flakes and lime.
steps: Dice all the fruit.
Toss with lime juice.
Top with coconut flakes and mint.

title: Hummus & Veggie Sticks
description: Creamy hummus with crunchy carrot, cucumber and pepper sticks.
steps: Cut vegetables into sticks.
Serve with hummus for dipping.

title: Apple Slices with Almond Butter
description: Crisp apple wedges with almond butter and a pinch of cinnamon.
steps: Core and slice the apple.
Serve with almond butter sprinkled with cinnamon.

title: Spiced Roasted Chickpeas
description: Crunchy oven-roasted chickpeas with smoked paprika.
steps: Heat oven to 400°F.
Dry the rinsed chickpeas well and toss with oil and spices.
Roast 25–30 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy.

title: Edamame with Sea Salt
description: Steamed edamame pods with flaky salt and lemon.
steps: Boil or steam edamame for 5 minutes.
Drain and toss with salt and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Cottage Cheese & Pineapple
description: High-protein cottage cheese with juicy pineapple.
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with pineapple and a drizzle of honey.

title: Turkey & Cheese Roll-Ups
description: Sliced turkey rolled with cheese, cucumber and mustard.
steps: Lay out turkey and spread with mustard.
Add half a cheese slice and a cucumber strip to each.
Roll up tightly.

title: Guacamole with Veggie Chips
description: Fresh guacamole served with sliced jicama, radish and cucumber.
steps: Mash avocados with lime juice and salt.
Fold in diced onion, tomato and cilantro.
Slice jicama, radishes and serve alongside.
